official_questions.stem: Before the formation of Andhra Pradesh, an agreement popularly known as Gentlemen's Agreement was signed. How many leaders signed on it ?

official_questions.rule: Gentlemen's Agreement: 20 Feb 1956, 8 signatories (4+4), Regional Council, safeguards for Telangana.

official_questions.rule: Six-Point Formula 1973 -> 32nd Amendment -> Art. 371D (Presidential Order 1975), 371E (Central University, Hyderabad).
